tasks.title: Investigate placeholder URL occurrences
tasks.description: Scan the repository for all instances of `[your-org]` or other placeholder strings in URLs to identify every file and line that needs updating.
acceptanceCriteria: Run `grep -rn '\[your-org\]' /home/deploy/gc-repos/care-tools/` — document all matches found in README.md and LICENSE

tasks.title: Replace placeholder URLs in README.md
tasks.description: Replace all `[your-org]` placeholders in README.md with the actual GitHub org `givecareapp`, pointing to the correct repo `github.com/givecareapp/care-tools`.

tasks.title: Replace placeholder URLs in LICENSE
tasks.description: Replace all `[your-org]` placeholders in LICENSE with `givecareapp` so that any GitHub URLs reference the correct organization.

tasks.title: Scan for any remaining placeholder URLs repo-wide
tasks.description: Search the entire repository for any other `[your-org]` or similar bracket-placeholder patterns in URLs that may have been missed.

tasks.title: Verify build and test commands pass
tasks.description: Run the project's build and test commands to confirm no regressions were introduced by the placeholder replacements.
acceptanceCriteria: Run `cd /home/deploy/gc-repos/care-tools && npm run build` — exits with code 0
Run `cd /home/deploy/gc-repos/care-tools && npm run test` — exits with code 0
